title: org-config-v2
description: An org config as pushed to the gateway (PUT /-/orgs/{org_id}/config and the bulk sync), contract v2. The shape is the OrgConfig definition of the admin contract; this file only points at it, so the two can never drift. Resolve the reference by registering ../agentcc-admin.schema.json under its $id. meta and managed_models.upstream_keys exist only in pushed payloads, never in a saved config.
